children: is reportedly evaluating a fresh round of
, which would elevate its valuation up to $1.2T.
This would push its valuation above its chief rival, Anthropic
, which most recently reached a $965B valuation. The potential fresh funding round for OpenAI signals continued momentum for AI demand, according to the financial analysts at Macquarie.

"The reported fundraising discussions follow what appears to be a meaningful reacceleration in OpenAI's commercial momentum after concerns earlier this year around competition from Anthropic; OpenAI's reported $40bn ARR is roughly a doubling from earlier this year," said Macquarie analysts Paul Golding and Alex Luthringer in an investor note. "This momentum, further boosted by the GPT-5.6 and Astra releases, suggests model performance continues to translate into incremental enterprise and consumer adoption, supporting our view that AI infrastructure is in a supply-constrained position."
The move also proves positive for SoftBank, as OpenAI continues to experience high demand for its models. SoftBank is also benefiting from the British chip company Arm
, of which the bank is a majority owner. Macquarie rates SoftBank with an Outperform rating.

"Beyond the direct valuation benefit, we believe this development further validates SoftBank Group's broader AI strategy spanning OpenAI, Arm, AI infrastructure, data centers, power assets, and robotics," Golding noted. "As OpenAI's enterprise adoption, revenue base, and valuation scale, the strategic linkage between OpenAI and SBG's AI infrastructure investments and other portfolio companies can become even more impactful."

title: OpenAI's latest funding round indicates sustained AI momentum: Macquarie
